analysis.title: Spotlight | Midterms
key_insights: Midterms are next Wednesday. The author sees a Democratic sweep as the clear risk, and says opinions vary on whether it is an equities-higher or equities-lower scenario.
It is hard to gauge how much is priced in from this week's moves, because EPS misses have been severely punished, especially in mega cap and AI names.

US hedge fund gross positioning is not light, at about the 64th percentile over 1 year and 86th percentile over 3 years (data one week old), so positioning risk may have to be carried into the midterms.
Clients, both hedge funds and long-only, are in P&L protection mode at this time of year, so large new bets are unlikely. The author expects more jittery trading next week.
A Binance headline overnight is weighing on sentiment for risk assets. The author says there is no panic yet.

Korea memory: Hynix's beat optimism faded after Samsung reported an in-line print, with slightly weaker NAND profit offset by smaller smartphone losses. Investors were disappointed that Samsung announced no buyback, unlike Hynix.
GS analyst Giuni Lee expects Samsung to announce in Jan 2027 a W70tn year-end shareholder return, split 40 dividends and 30 buybacks/cancellation.

Komatsu fell on a 2Q miss caused by one-off costs tied to Thai floods and materials, while underlying business momentum is described as on track. GS recently upgraded it on a US data centre angle, which the author says carries policy risk into the midterms.
Keyence is a Conviction Buy idea with a 2Q beat. The production and procurement constraints the market worries about most were not seen, and the company maintained its same-day delivery model.
China autos remain a tough sector: BYD posted weaker revenue despite cost savings, and Geely showed domestic volume weakness and a product mix change.

GS analyst Isayama initiated Synspective at Buy. It is a Japanese small SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite operator with national security applications, and revenue is forecast to grow at a +90% CAGR over the next 5 years. Catalysts are Japan's late-2026 security strategy revisions and the 2027 defense budget rollout.
The rest of the note is a GS Launchpad calendar of corporate access events, webinars, NDRs, conferences and field trips, including an Election Post-Mortem webinar with Politico's Jonathan Martin.

market_movers.rationale: Initiated on Synspective, a Japanese small SAR satellite operator, with revenue forecast to grow at a +90% CAGR over 5 years. Catalysts are Japan's late-2026 security strategy revisions and the 2027 defense budget.
Keyence is called a Conviction Buy idea after a 2Q beat. The production and procurement constraints the market worries about were not seen, and the same-day delivery model was maintained.
Komatsu fell on a 2Q miss from one-off costs tied to Thai floods and materials. The recent GS upgrade rests on a US data centre angle that carries policy risk into the midterms.
GS expects Samsung to announce in Jan 2027 a W70tn year-end shareholder return split 40 dividends and 30 buybacks/cancellation, after no buyback was announced with its in-line quarter.

sector_views.rationale: Hynix beat, while Samsung was in line with slightly weaker NAND profit and no buyback announced.
Still a tough sector, with misses from BYD (weaker revenue) and Geely (domestic volume weakness and product mix change).
